description: Cartographie du réseau de froid urbain parisien Climespace is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Aurélien TABARAUD. This dataset published in opendata corresponds to the route of the pipes of the Parisian urban cold network Climespace. The publication of this dataset does not exempt the user from its regulatory obligation under the Anti-damage Decree (DT/DICT) in case of work. This data comes from the public mapping published on the Climespace website. Coverage: Aurélien TABARAUD. The portal shows the English title as "Cartography of the Parisian urban cold network Climespace" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Aurélien TABARAUD. The listing shows 1 download or service links in KML. The listing shows 2018-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
